Yo!
Champ in the making!\c
Even I don’t know who the Viridian City Gym
Leader is.\c
But one thing’s certain:\c
you’re qualified to challenge the Gym Leader
because you have [VAR COLOR(0006)]seven Badges[VAR COLOR(0000)]!\c
This Gym Leader will be stronger than any
other Trainers you’ve ever faced.\c
Also, I heard that the Trainers here are
users of Ground-type Pokémon.
That just blew my mind! Giovanni was the Gym\nLeader of Viridian City? It was too dark to tell!
A new Viridian City Gym Leader has arrived!

BLUE: Stopped by to say hello, huh?\c
Don’t you worry. Now that I’m a Gym Leader,
I’m gonna make sure that all the Trainers in
Kanto are up to my standard!
